basic_info.description: Gorgeous home with abundant living space in an unbeatable Noe location. The main level hosts a double parlor room which has been opened for modern living, a comfortable family room opening up to an updated elegant kitchen with a walk-in pantry and french doors leading to a walkout deck & garden. A laundry room, full bath, and large storage closet complete this level. Upstairs features four bedrooms + a family room and two full bathrooms, including a primary suite with a sitting area/office. FOUR car garage + storage.
